title: Block 41: localize flat spin-two gravity boundary
science: Block 41: combines exact ten-ray derivative envelopes with a finite-volume Dobrushin-Poincare inequality to give uniform spin-two Gram stiffness gaps (E>=4.715, T2>=1.093) on every periodic carrier and every Block-40 Gram, with vanishing mixed block — so any regular connection Schur inverse keeps an O(k^0) spin-two intercept, retiring the unchanged regular flat-law route to a massless Einstein/Reg
carried_by: #6132 finalizes the route's death by proving the flat branch itself unstable (explicitly framed against the merely-massless escape); ancestry of #7753
